questions.question: What sacred chest were the Israelites told to build to hold the covenant?
What did God ask the people to bring for building the sanctuary?
options: The spoils taken from Egypt's drowned army
A tenth of all their grain and livestock
A yearly tax of one silver shekel each
Freewill offerings of gold, silver, and linen
questions.answer: Freewill offerings of gold, silver, and linen
